name: agent-researcher
description: Deep-research API on GCP: pluggable AI models, web-search agent, structured markdown reports in Cloud Storage.

scripts.test: npm run test -w @agent-researcher/core && npm run test -w @agent-researcher/api && npm run test -w @agent-researcher/worker && npm run test -w @agent-researcher/fbizlab && npm run test -w @agent-researcher/admin
scripts.test:local-llm: TEST_LLM=ollama npm run test -w @agent-researcher/core && TEST_LLM=ollama npm run test -w @agent-researcher/api
scripts.llm:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d --wait ollama && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml run --rm puller
